scope: Standalone backend atomic head-result write and retirement. No CSR instruction dispatch, CSR-bank connection, MRET redirect, IQ serialization or full-core acceptance.
contract: serial_offer_i supplies a held, final, legal non-trapping event and full ROB identity for an unfinished solo non-CFI head entry. Entry PC, rd address and write mask must match ownership; resultless events have rd_value=0. serial_ready_o reports qualification independent of offer and downstream readiness. Only serial_accept_o authorizes external architectural side effects. It equals the single normal retire acceptance for the selected candidate. Nonzero destination writes and committed-map/stale-tag updates happen on that same edge; no earlier completion or wakeup is permitted. Event order/valid/retired are assigned by the ROB.
arbitration: Reset, full flush, a pending trap and recover_hold_i (an offered mispredict or the registered recovery cycle) prevent serial acceptance. A serial offer reserves the retirement lane and blocks allocation even under backpressure; ordinary completions continue beside it, and a serial result write waits while lane zero offers a completion, which owns write port zero. retire_ready_i[0] is joint event-sink and external CSR-side-effect readiness; lane one cannot retire with it. The caller holds the event until acceptance or cancellation and owns upstream serialization/recovery priority.
integration: This standalone gate drives rename_rob directly. Production issue_backend forwards the serial interface to execution_backend head-service owners; their CSR-bank, MRET redirect and memory integration are outside this gate. Illegal head results use the precise trap path, not normal serial retirement. Reset also resets external identity holders; generations must not wrap without existing global drain.
